title: Why Only ONE Company Can Build This Machine
description:
Why can only one company in the world build this machine? The most advanced chips in your phone are printed with it, and no other company sells one.

Inside, it fires about 50,000 drops of molten tin every second. A laser hits each drop twice: first to flatten it, then to blast it into plasma hotter than the surface of the Sun. That plasma glows with extreme ultraviolet (EUV) light, which can print lines thousands of times thinner than a human hair. Its mirrors are so smooth that, scaled up to the size of Germany, the tallest bump would be no higher than a millimetre. Decades of work, in one machine: that's why nobody can copy it.
